textbookText: 1. Which of the following must have the same value for two bodies to be in thermal equilibrium? a. specific heat capacity b. heat energy c. temperature d. thermal conductivity

2. Which of the following pairs of temperature scales can never give the equal numerical value of the temperature of a body? a. Kelvin and Fahrenheit b. Fahrenheit and Celsius c. Kelvin and Celsius d. Reaumur and Rankine
3. One thermometer has a spherical bulb and another has a cylindrical bulb. Which
thermometer responds more quickly to the temperature change?
d. depends on temperature of the body

4. A graph showing the temperature in C along the X-axis and temperature in F along the Y-axis is a straight line. Which of the following statements is correct? a. Line intercepts the positive X-axis. b. Line intercepts the positive Y-axis. c. Line passes through origin. d. Line intercepts on the negative of both axes.
5. What is the temperature at which the reading of the Fahrenheit scale becomes three
times the reading on the Celsius scale?
6. Upper and lower fixed points on a thermometer are separated by 0.160m. The length of
mercury thread above the lower fixed point is 0.040m. What is the value of temperature
7. If the temperature of a body measured by the Celsius scale is 15C, then what is the
temperature value of the same body measured by the Fahrenheit scale?
8. A faulty thermometer has its upper fixed point marked at 60C. This thermometer reads
the temperature of a body as 40C. If the correct temperature on the Celsius scale is
50C, then what is the ice point of the faulty thermometer?
9. The lower fixed points of two scales X and Y are marked at 14C and 25C, and upper
fixed points are marked at 74C and 120C respectively. If the reading of body on the
X- scale is 50C then what is the reading of the same body on the Y-scale?
10. The temperature of a substance increases by 27C on the Celsius scale. What is the
value of this increment on the Kelvin scale?

Explain, in terms of energy flow, why the concept of temperature would be meaningless if this law is not obeyed.

14. A centigrade and a Fahrenheit thermometer are placed in hot water. The water is then
cooled. What fall of temperature will the Fahrenheit thermometer register, when the
centigrade thermometer records the fall in temperature of 45C.
15. A faulty thermometer has its fixed points marked at 2 and 98. What is the correct
temperature on the Celsius scale when the thermometer reads 20?
16. Find the value of absolute zero on Celsius and Fahrenheit scales. [–273C, –495.97F]
